items.title: Sid Davilla Interview, 1969-04-17
items.q: I didn't have any association with him... I didn't know about him too well

ctx.x: Yeah, he died about, uh, he died about, uh, ten, twelve years ago. He was no, uh, uh, no versatile musician, but he'd played the piano by ear, and he could manage to put a few notes down on paper, you see. But he, uh, I guess he had written and recorded many, many songs. Uh, Gene Austin recorded some of his songs, and, uh, the sister trio that came out of New Orleans, the Basel Sisters, you know, they're from New Orleans. As a matter of fact, he managed them for a while. But I didn't have any association with…
Did you have any other music in your family at all?
